title: Withdrawn Payment Plans and the Term of a New Ostomy Supply Program Plan
content:
An earlier plan the customer withdrew shortens an Ostomy Supply Program payment plan: a payment plan request of the program received in the last 24 months and since withdrawn takes off the recent-withdrawal months, a withdrawn payment plan request received more than 24 months ago with none received in the last 24 months takes off the older-withdrawal months, and otherwise nothing is taken off.

| Withdrawn payment plan requests of the program | Months taken off the number of installments |
|---|---|
| One received in the last 24 months and since withdrawn | 2 (the recent-withdrawal months) |
| One received more than 24 months ago and since withdrawn, none received in the last 24 months | 1 (the older-withdrawal month) |
| None | Nothing |

A request is dated by the day it was received; the last 24 months are counted back from the day the plan is set up in whole calendar months.

These months are taken off the number of installments.

**Cases (hypothetical).** A request received 10 months ago and later withdrawn: 2 months off. A request received 30 months ago and withdrawn, with no withdrawn request received since: 1 month off. Never withdrawn: nothing off.
